name: scherlok
description: Profile your database, learn what normal looks like, and let Claude tell you when something changed.
long_description:
Scherlok gives Claude read-only tools to monitor data quality in your warehouse.

Ask it to profile your tables once, and it stores a baseline: row counts, column types, NULL rates, value distributions, freshness cadence and cardinality. From then on it can compare the current state against that baseline and report what drifted — volume drops and spikes, schema changes, stale tables, NULL surges, distribution shifts, cardinality explosions — each scored INFO, WARNING or CRITICAL. There are no rules or thresholds to write.

The connection string is resolved by the server from your settings and is never passed by the model. Every operation is read-only (SELECT and information_schema), there is no arbitrary-SQL tool, and results are capped so a single call cannot exhaust the conversation.

Works with PostgreSQL, MySQL and DuckDB. The command-line version adds BigQuery and Snowflake.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables visible to the configured warehouse connection

tools.name: investigate
tools.description: Profile tables and store them as the baseline for future anomaly checks

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Profile tables and detect anomalies against the stored baseline

tools.name: history
tools.description: Return anomalies recorded in the last N days

tools.name: check
tools.description: Run a watch over all tables and return a CI-style pass/fail gate

connection_string.title: Database connection
connection_string.description: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname — also mysql://user:password@host:3306/dbname or duckdb:///path/to/file.db. A read-only user is enough.
